verdict.rationale: Open WebUI documents a cross-conversation memory system where users can manually add, edit, or delete memories under Settings > Personalization > Memory. Because the platform is self-hosted and built to run entirely offline, the memory store plausibly lives on the user's own machine. Missing for 10: no evidence the memory store uses an open, directly inspectable format, no docs on where or how memories are stored on disk, and no independent or hands-on corroboration.
